name: RNA 2D (secondary) structure prediction benchmark
description: Evaluates machine learning methods for predicting RNA secondary (2D) structure against experimental reference data.
reputation: A well-established evaluation target in the computational RNA community used to compare machine-learning and thermodynamic secondary-structure predictors.
notes: Focuses on secondary (2D) structure only — tertiary interactions and pseudoknots may be excluded or variably handled; benchmarks can be sensitive to sequence length distributions and experimental annotation quality; non-LLM, domain-specific dataset with potential dataset bias and varying evaluation protocols across studies.
